issue.body:

Update `com.google.ads.interactivemedia.v3:interactivemedia` to at least version `3.13.1` and try to load an ad.

Any VAST link, for example one of these test links: https://www.iab.com/insights/vast-2-0-xml-samples-for-testing/

```java

    at com.google.ads.interactivemedia.v3.internal.afa.b(IMASDK:42)
    at com.google.ads.interactivemedia.v3.internal.aez.shouldOverrideUrlLoading(IMASDK:4)
    at android.webkit.WebViewClient.shouldOverrideUrlLoading(WebViewClient.java:83)
    at org.chromium.android_webview.AwContentsClientBridge.shouldOverrideUrlLoading(PG:16)
    at android.os.MessageQueue.nativePollOnce(Native Method)
    at android.os.MessageQueue.next(MessageQueue.java:336)
    at android.os.Looper.loop(Looper.java:174)
    at android.app.ActivityThread.main(ActivityThread.java:7559)

```

### [REQUIRED] Version of ExoPlayer being used
ExoPlayer: `2.10.4`
InteractiveMedia: `3.14.0`

### [REQUIRED] Device(s) and version(s) of Android being used
Any, but reproduced on OnePlus 7 Pro with Android 10 Beta.

repository.name: ExoPlayer

issue.body:
### [REQUIRED] Issue description
Memory leaks and SDK version issue in v2.9.6 

### [REQUIRED] Reproduction steps
I just started to implement the IMA extension in my application that has a video streaming feature using Exoplayer and everything works fine until a memory leaks appears when closing the app after this implementation even after calling `adsLoader.setPlayer(null)` in `onStop()` and `adsLoader.relase()` in `onDestroy()`. I am currently using a Single Skippable Inline: 
https://pubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads?sz=640x480&iu=/124319096/external/single_ad_samples&ciu_szs=300x250&impl=s&gdfp_req=1&env=vp&output=vast&unviewed_position_start=1&cust_params=deployment%3Ddevsite%26sample_ct%3Dskippablelinear&correlator=
From the documentation page here: 
https://developers.google.com/interactive-media-ads/docs/sdks/android/tags

Another thing is it seems like the SDK version is outdated, this is what I saw in a stacktrace whenever I play some video.
`Invalid internal message, ignoring. Please make sure the Google IMA SDK library is up to date.`

### [REQUIRED] Link to test content
N/A

Here is my full [stacktrace.txt](https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/files/2960437/stacktrace.txt)

### [REQUIRED] Version of ExoPlayer being used
Exoplayer dependency v2.9.6 

### [REQUIRED] Device(s) and version(s) of Android being used
LG K10 K430dsy Android M 6.0.0

issue.title: IMA extension: Playback ends before post roll completes

repository.name: ExoPlayer
repository.description: This project is deprecated and stale. The latest ExoPlayer code is available in https://github.com/androidx/media

issue.body:
### [REQUIRED] Issue description
When using the IMA extension on ad supported content with a post roll, the player frequently (>50% of the time from my guestimation) hits an ended state before the post roll has completed.

It also seems to not render the ad UI in the scenario where the ad will terminate before completion.

This was initially noticed in our application (iflix), we then dropped into the demo application to confirm it wasn't something dodgy in our code.

### [REQUIRED] Reproduction steps
- Open the demo app (built against 2.11.6 release-v2 with extensions enabled)
- Open any? of the IMA demos with post rolls, I've tried "VMAP post-roll", "VMAP pre,mid,post, single ads"
- Seek to just before the end
- Watch the post roll play and then end with the sample post roll timer at a value >1, in my testing so far the lowest I've seen it get, when it will fail, is 6 of 10s remaining.

You may need to repeat this a few times to see the issue reproduce. Personally it seems to happen 50% or more of the time, but I've seen it work a couple of times in a row before breaking again for e.g.

### [REQUIRED] Link to test content
This is reproducible in the demo app. But if necessary I can supply real world examples. 

### [REQUIRED] A full bug report captured from the device
[bugreport-marlin-QP1A.191005.007.A3-2020-06-26-22-23-46.zip](https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/files/4836882/bugreport-marlin-QP1A.191005.007.A3-2020-06-26-22-23-46.zip)

### [REQUIRED] Version of ExoPlayer being used
Reproducible on 2.11.6 release in a real world app, but also reproduced on a 2.11.6 release-v2 demo build with extensions (as described above).
This also seems to be reproducible on 2.11.5 after checking out the tag and running the demo app. So it does not seem to be related to the fixes in 2.11.6.

I've also tested with the IMA version bumped to 3.19.2 (compared to 3.19.0 that ExoPlayer currently depends on) as it has some kind of fix around content completion. This did not improve the situation.

### [REQUIRED] Device(s) and version(s) of Android being used
Pixel XL, Android 10.
